prior_project_use_of_nwicu: none found (repository-wide search for nwicu/northwestern/nw_hosp/nw_icu on 2026-10-14)

nwicu_data.cohort: all NWICU ICU stays with outtime > intime + horizon (whole-ICU, no disease module filter)
nwicu_data.label_tolerance_hours: min(2, horizon/2), nearest measurement to anchor + horizon

not_evaluable_by_design.observed_treatment_context_ridge cells (: NWICU has no inputevents; unit-safe treatment schema not available

declared_semantic_deviations: MAP derived as (SBP + 2*DBP)/3 from same-time arterial or non-invasive pairs; MIMIC MAP is device-measured mean
target_specific_change_hurdle recipes read pre-anchor treatment features; these are absent in NWICU and imputed with MIMIC training medians
variables absent in NWICU (ventilator settings, blood gases other than pH, biomarker expansion) are imputed with MIMIC training medians
primary_interval_method: value_conditional: Mondrian patient-cluster conformal, 5 current-value quintile bins with edges from MIMIC calibration rows only, nominal 0.90, bins with <30 calibration patients use the pooled width
secondary_interval_method: fixed: one patient-cluster conformal half-width (reported for comparison, not used for decisions)

gates.point: patient-cluster paired bootstrap 95% CI upper < 0 versus persistence and versus the recipe's matched comparator (hospital axis not applicable: single hospital)
gates.interval: patient-equal and care-unit-equal coverage both in [0.87, 0.93] (care-unit replaces hospital: single hospital)
gates.binary_event_cells: point gate only (Brier versus persistence and MIMIC prevalence)
gates.full_pass: point gate and primary interval gate

primary_endpoint: list and count of evaluable cells with full pass under the primary interval method
decision_rule: A full pass makes a cell eligible for promotion review as an externally replicated candidate. No automatic runtime promotion. Failures stay on their existing validated expert or persistence.
one_shot_rule: The NWICU scoring command is run once. If it crashes, only the crash may be fixed; any fix must leave methods, gates and cohorts unchanged, and is reported with the frozen hash mismatch it causes.
